This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''Thyferran''' was the [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] of former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] during her tenure as [[Chief Operating Officer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The secretary favored wearing skimpy [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], which to [[Minister of Trade]] [[Fliry Vorru]]'s estimation, covered less skin compared to her long [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="The Bacta War" />
